response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(li.product_quantity AS INTEGER)), 0) AS quantity FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS li JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = li.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), stats AS (SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_per_color, SUM(quantity) AS overall_quantity FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(ct.quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(1.0 * ct.quantity / NULLIF(s.overall_quantity, 0)) AS average_share, AVG(ct.quantity - s.average_per_color) AS average_excess FROM color_totals AS ct CROSS JOIN stats AS s WHERE ct.quantity > s.average_per_color

assumptions.assumption: The per-color average includes colors that appear on invoice line items; product quantities are numeric text that can be cast to integers.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every color in the product catalog, assigning zero quantity to colors with no invoice line items.
